info.title: Ultiwrite API
info.description:
Ultiwrite is operated by DWS Offshore Fund dba Ultiwrite. Ultiwrite examines the documents and evidence behind opportunities, organizations, counterparties, acquisitions, financings and portfolios, and returns released findings: source economics, document integrity, material contradictions, unresolved claims and the next diligence move. The API never renders an autonomous approve or decline.

Partner API (dashboard API key or OAuth 2.1): explicitly approved accounts submit evidence, continue asynchronous processing and read the released report. Polling uses API requests but no additional analysis credits. Reports are never assumed to be immediate.

Provisioned routes authenticate with an admin-issued uw_live_ API key and are listed by name only.

Versioning: the major version is in the path (/api/v1). Within v1, changes are additive; a field or operation is removed only after a deprecation notice in this document (deprecated: true) and the changelog. Response header Ultiwrite-Api-Version identifies the contract revision.

API access requires an explicit administrator grant, independent of paid plan. Monthly and fixed-minute request limits are pooled across every key and partner OAuth grant on the account. Every admitted request, including polling and authenticated validation errors, uses one request; failed authentication and quota denials do not. Analysis credits use the existing separate ledger. Exceeding a limit returns 429 with Retry-After.

Dashboard keys support read_only (ultiwrite:read) and investigator (read plus evidence) roles. Customer key monthly and per-minute caps only reduce account allowances; a monthly key cap of0 pauses that key. Omitted or null key caps follow the pooled account policy. Key roles are immutable; rotate a replacement key to change its permissions. API keys never grant staff or optional checkout authority.

Released report artifacts are downloadable with this Partner API bearer under /reports/{reportId}/artifacts/{artifact}. Read-only keys can retrieve entitled JSON, commercial PDF, issued document-forensics PDF, CSV, Excel and ZIP. Existing MCP and native-client delivery boundaries are unchanged; tokens must target this exact Partner API resource.

get.summary: Download an entitled released report artifact
get.description: Partner API bearer delivery using the same saved customer publication, tenant check, export entitlements, renderers and volume limits as website downloads. Read-only keys work. The original credential, current account API approval, publication revision and export permissions are rechecked after preparation. One admitted request, no new analysis credit. MCP-resource tokens and native-client-only grants do not authorize this resource. JSON uses the existing commercial customer projection. ZIP includes the requested complete formats and ordered volumes. No presigned URL or shareable access is issued.

post.summary: Create a Stripe checkout for user approval
post.description:
Creates an account-bound Stripe-hosted Checkout URL for an existing one-time investigation offer. The user must review and approve payment on Stripe. Link creation is not payment and grants no credit or API access. Uses the same prices, eligibility, account checkout throttle, metadata and fulfillment as browser checkout. Document Forensics requires an owned unstarted P1/P2 portal file collection ID, not an API case ID. Never accepts account, price, amount, payment credentials or return URLs.

Idempotency: Stripe idempotency is namespaced by account, offer, bound investigation and purchase-attempt key. Retry the same selection/key after uncertain responses. Do not create another checkout while payment is pending.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable 16–128 character purchase-attempt key. Retry the same offer and investigation with the same key. A different selection is a different purchase.

requestBody.description: Approved offer and, only for Document Forensics, its portal file collection ID.

200.description: Private checkout URL requiring user action; no payment or credit is claimed.

get.description:
Reads Stripe payment facts for this account and uses the canonical verified receipt fulfillment/recovery path. A browser return, checkout URL or caller payment assertion is never proof of payment. Only state credited confirms the account ledger was updated. Pending, failed, expired, reversed and needs_review remain distinct; never request another payment while confirmation is pending. Each check uses an API request, with an additional shared status throttle.

Idempotency: Verified fulfillment shares the exact receipt and single canonical grant with webhooks and browser return recovery. Repeated checks cannot issue a second credit.

UltiwriteApiKey.description: Create a key at /settings/api after an administrator approves your account. The key is shown once, can be revoked, and shares the account request allowance with other keys and partner OAuth grants. Send only in Authorization. These keys are not accepted by MCP or the legacy provisioned routes.

UltiwriteOAuth.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE (S256), public clients (token_endpoint_auth_method none). Register a client (RFC 7591) at https://dwsoffshorepartners.com/api/integrations/ultiwrite/oauth/register; registration accepts only approved HTTPS callbacks or a native loopback callback http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback with application_type native. Send resource=https://dwsoffshorepartners.com/api/v1 (RFC 8707) on the authorization and token requests; tokens for any other resource are refused. Access tokens last 10 minutes; refresh tokens last 14 days and rotate; authorization codes expire after 60 seconds.
